entities.name: Balgot
entities.description: Orcish general in the Eastern Domains of Dominaria during the Time of Legends who killed Red Donald.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: Elder Dragon who brought Balgot to Mors Ridge.

entities.name: Red Donald
entities.description: Leader of the Army of the Valley, killed by Balgot with a poisoned blade.

entities.name: Army of the Valley
entities.description: Army that fought at the Battle at Mors Ridge.

entities.name: Battle at Mors Ridge
entities.description: Battle in which Balgot killed Red Donald.

events.summary: Palladia-Mors brings Balgot to Mors Ridge to fight Red Donald and the Army of the Valley.
events.quote: Balgot was brought to Mors Ridge by the Elder Dragon Palladia-Mors

events.summary: Balgot kills Red Donald with a poisoned blade and is later presumed killed.
events.quote: He killed Red Donald with a poisoned blade

relations.note: With a poisoned blade at Mors Ridge.
relations.quote: He killed Red Donald with a poisoned blade

relations.note: Brought to battle by the Elder Dragon.
